script:
{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; for i in 1 2; do x=new /bin/true; echo i=$i; done; echo after-for; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; x=new /bin/true; echo same-line; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; eval 'x=new /bin/true; echo in-eval1
echo in-eval2'; echo after-eval; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; echo a | x=new /bin/true; echo "after-pipe s=$?"; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; f(){ i=0; while [ $i -lt 2 ]; do i=$((i+1)); x=new /bin/true; echo i=$i; done; echo end-f; }; f; echo after; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; f(){ x=new /bin/true; echo in-f; }; eval 'f; echo in-eval1
echo in-eval2'; echo after-eval; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; v=$(x=new /bin/true; echo in-comsub); echo "v=$v s=$?"; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; x=new /bin/true || echo or; echo after-or; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; if x=new /bin/true; then echo t; else echo e; fi; echo after-if; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; trap 'echo entered; x=new /bin/true; echo in-trap' ERR; false; echo after-trap; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; { x=new /bin/true; echo in-brace; }; echo after-brace; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; trap 'echo entered; x=new :; echo in-trap' ERR; false; echo after-trap; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; f(){ x=new :; echo in-f; }; f; echo after-f; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; f(){ x=new /bin/true; echo in-bg; }; f & wait $!; echo "after-bg s=$?"; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ readonly x=1; x=2; echo same; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ readonly x=old; f(){ x=new /bin/true; echo in-f; }; f; echo after-f; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ readonly x=1; eval 'x=2; echo in-eval1
echo in-eval2'; echo after-eval; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ readonly x=1; f(){ x=2; echo in-f; }; f; echo after-f; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ readonly x=1; ( x=2; echo in-sub ); echo after-sub; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=1; f(){ x=2; echo in-f; }; f; echo after-f; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ readonly x=1; command eval 'x=2'; echo same; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ (set -o posix; readonly x=old; f() { x=new /bin/true; }; f; echo continued); echo status=$?; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; f(){ x=new /bin/true; echo in-f; }; f; echo after-f; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=1; eval 'x=2; echo in-eval1
echo in-eval2'; echo after-eval; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=1; command eval 'x=2'; echo same; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=1; x=2; echo same; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; x=new /bin/true | cat; echo "after-pipe s=$?"; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=old; f(){ x=new /bin/true; echo in-f; }; g(){ f; echo in-g; }; g; echo after-g; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ d=$(mktemp -d); cd "$d"; set -o posix; readonly x=old; printf 'x=new /bin/true; echo in-src1\necho in-src2\n' >s.sh; . ./s.sh; echo after-src; cd /; rm -rf "$d"; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"

{ set -o posix; readonly x=1; ( x=2; echo in-sub ); echo after-sub; } 2>/dev/null
echo "next s=$?"
